title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement Game's New Gameplay Trailer Streamed
content:
The "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday revealed a new trailer for ArtPlay and 505 Games' Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement game . The gameplay trailer highlights new characters, environments, enemies, and new gameplay mechanics.

The game's official website announced last month the game has been delayed to 2027. ArtPlay co-founder Koji Igarashi stated that the game has entered the final stages of development.

The game was initially announced for release this year for the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store.

ArtPlay and 505 Games describe the game:

Set in a haunting world years before the events of Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night, Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement follows Leo and the fearless Black Wolves as they prepare to storm the cursed Ethereal Castle and confront the rising darkness. Under the command of Lord Theodore, the warriors face horrific beasts and the malevolent Demon Lord Elias in a brutal battle for humanity's survival.

Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night launched for the PlayStation 4, Windows, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox One in June 2019. Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon launched for the Nintendo 3DS, Nintendo Switch, PS4, PlayStation Vita, and Windows in May 2018, and for Xbox One in June 2018. Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2 launched for PS4, Switch, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in July 2020.

ArtPlay creative director SHUTARO (Shutaro Iida), who was also leading the development of Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement , died on February 10 due to pancreatic cancer. Igarashi stated then that the staff will strive to complete the game worthy of SHUTARO's vision and name.
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta Game Streams Gameplay Trailer, Reveals Official Title
content:
Com2uS Group streamed the "gameplay reveal" video and announced the official title GACHIAKUTA : BREAKOUT for its RPG based on Kei Urana 's Gachiakuta manga, during the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday.

The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027.

The game's initial working title was Gachiakuta : The Game and it aims to reimagine the atmosphere of the anime. The survival action RPG will enable players to enter the anime's setting.

Urana launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in February 2022. Hideyoshi Ando is credited for graffiti design. Kodansha published the manga's 19th compiled book volume on July 16.

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Rudo lives in the slums of a floating town, where the poor scrape by under the shadow of the rich who live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. Then one day, he's falsely accused of murder, and his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and if Rudo wants to have any hope of discovering the truth and seeking vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, he will have to master a new power and join a group known as the Cleaners who battle the hulking trash beasts of the Pit!

The television anime adaptation of the manga debuted in Japan in July 2025 on CBC , TBS , and 26 other channels. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in the following territories: North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS (excluding Russia and Belarus), and the Indian subcontinent. Crunchyroll is also streaming an English dub for the series. The anime ended its broadcast in December 2025 with the 24th episode.

The anime will get a second season.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Sixth Opening Featuring "EASY GO" by Kazuki Kato
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its sixth opening, featuring the song “EASY GO” by Kazuki Kato. The song was used in Episodes 127-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the ninth ending, featuring the song “Suberidai” by Mori Tsubasa . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Streams Naoto Shirogane Trailer
content:
Atlus revealed a new English dub trailer for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, during the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday, featuring the character Naoto Shirogane. The video also reveals that Amber Lee Connors will voice the character in its English dub .

Atlus also revealed the same video in Japanese, featuring voice actress Romi Park .

The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC with Xbox Game Pass, and PC via Steam on February 18. The game will also launch for Nintendo Switch 2 on May 20. The remake will feature a new English voice cast.

Animation studio MAPPA will work on all the animated cutscenes in the game.

The original Persona 4 launched for PlayStation 2 in 2008. The game received a port for PlayStation Vita in 2011 under the title Persona 4 Golden . The franchise inspired several spin-off games, including Persona 4 Arena and its sequel Persona 4 Arena Ultimax , and Persona 4 : Dancing All Night .

Persona 3 Reload , the remake of Atlus ' Persona 3 RPG, launched for PS5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Windows and Steam in February 2024. The game was also available for Xbox Game Pass at launch. The game launched for Switch 2 in October 2025.

title: Kojima Productions' Physint Game Casts Bill Skarsgård in Lead Role
content:
Hideo Kojima appeared on the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday and revealed updates for Kojima Productions ' planned OD KNOCK and PHYSINT games, including revealing Bill Skarsgård will be the lead actor for the PHYSINT game.

The stream also revealed a visual for the game.

For Kojima Productions ' new horror game OD KNOCK , Kojima stated performance capture and ADR recording have resumed after being paused during the SAG strike, adding production is "proceeding on schedule." Kojima and Kojima Productions are developing the game alongside Xbox Game Studios.

For PHYSINT , Kojima stated the development team is making progress on casting, talent scans, and collaborations with outside creators.

Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) announced last week it will no longer publish the PHYSINT action espionage game . On the same day, Microsoft 's Xbox Game Studios announced that it is taking over publishing for the game.

Kojima's Death Stranding game shipped for PlayStation 4 in November 2019. The game launched on PC via Steam in July 2020 after a delay from June 2020 due to COVID-19. Death Stranding: Director's Cut , the PlayStation 5 version of the game, launched in September 2021. Death Stranding: Director's Cut launched for PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store in March 2022. Death Stranding: On the Beach , the second game, launched for PlayStation 5 in June 2025, and launched on PC via Steam and Epic Game Store on March 19.

The game is inspiring a film adaptation at Hammerstone Studios ( Barbarian, Bill and Ted Face the Music ). Director Michael Sarnoski ( Pig, A Quiet Place: Day One ) is set to write and direct the film.

As a separate project, the franchise is inspiring a new adult animated feature set in the universe of the game. The animated film will tell an original story. Hiroshi Miyamoto ( Eiga Precure Dream Stars! , Hugtto! Precure Futari wa Precure All Stars Memories ) is directing the project at ABC ANIMATION STUDIO . The film's working title is DEATH STRANDING MOSQUITO .

Another separate project, an anime series titled Death Stranding Isolations , will debut in 2027 on Disney+ .
author: ANN

title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour Game Introduces Japan Map in New Video
content:
Sega presented in a new video the Japan Map of its Crazy Taxi : World Tour , a new entry in its racing game series, during the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday.

The game will launch for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Microsoft Store in 2027.

Sega discloses on the game's Steam page :

At SEGA Corporation, we utilize generative AI as a support tool for developers, aiming to provide better content to our users and enable developers to focus more on creative tasks. We have used such generative AI support tools during development of Crazy Taxi : World Tour. No AI was used in reference to the performers in the game.

Netflix announced on Monday that it is collaborating with Sega to create adaptations of its games, including a live-action film based on the Crazy Taxi series.

Sega announced a reboot game in 2022.

Crazy Taxi initially launched in arcades in February 1999 and then on the Sega Dreamcast console in January 2000. The game has two sequels and has two ported re-releases in the form of Crazy Taxi : Catch a Ride for Gameboy Advance and Crazy Taxi : Fare Wars for PlayStation Portable. The free-to-play Android and iOS game Crazy Taxi City Rush launched in March 2014 and the Crazy Taxi Tycoon spin-off game launched for Android and iOS in 2017. The latter game was delisted in 2020.
author: ANN

title: Man-God Laughs at Rudy in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 13 Preview
content:
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 13 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 20 premiere. The anime has introduced the future Rudeus and set up a dark atmosphere for the rest of the season, with the upcoming episode set to reveal the contents of the future diary. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .

You can see the preview images and synopsis for Episode 13 below.

“Consult Nanahoshi. Send a letter to Eris. Be wary of the Man-God, but do not antagonize him.” These were the words left behind by Rudeus from the future. Rudeus opens the diary entrusted to him by his elderly future self. Within its pages lies the harrowing account of the life his future self endured, a tragic journey that began with Roxy’s death.

ALSO READ: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Blu-ray Volume 2 Reveals Shirotaka Jacket Artwork Featuring Current and Future Rudeus

The main staff for the anime was previously announced and includes:

• Director: Ryosuke Shibuya

• Character Design: Sanae Shimada, Ryota Furukawa

• Music: Yoshiaki Fujisawa

• Studio: Studio Bind

You can also check out the teaser trailer for the ongoing arc below.

Season 3 began with Volume 14, for which Seven Seas describes the story: Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their number is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

You can also see the key visual for the third season.

The anime is based on a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote with Shirotaka’s illustrations. Seven Seas is publishing the light novel in English. The series is also launching a game titled Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation – Chronicle of Echoes this year. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases developed by ASOBIMO.

title: Devils’ Crest Anime Unveils Additional Voice Cast Members
content:
The production team for the upcoming Devils’ Crest anime has revealed the voice actors for four of the show’s characters. They also released several character and VA visuals alongside the news. Devils’ Crest ’s newest voice actors include:

• Maaya Uchida (Rikka in Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusion!) as Aria Misono

• Rie Murakawa (Hotaru in Non Non Biyori) as Kai Kisanuki

• Sora Amamiya (Akame in Akame ga Kill!) as Sumika Watamaki

• Yuusuke Kobayashi (Subaru in Re: ZERO) as Teruki Sugamo

Devils’ Crest’s production team had previously announced that Konomi Inagaki and Haruka Shiraishi would voice Sawa Ashihara and Yuuma Ashihara. During AX 2026 the production team announced that Ado would perform the anime’s opening song “Shinka.” The AX 2026 video and a trailer can be seen below:

The anime’s production staff includes:

• Shinji Ushiro — Chief Director

• Kenchirou Komaya — Director

• Eiji Umehara — Scripts

• Naoyuki Chikatani — Music

• Yuki Hayashi — Music

• Yukiko Horiguchi — Character Design

Production I.G. will animate the adaptation.

The anime adapts Reki Kawahara’s ( Sword Art Online, Accel World ) and Yukuko Horiguchi’s Demons’ Crest light novel. Dengeki Bunko (Kadokawa) has serialized the light novel since its November 2022 debut. Kadokawa has released four volumes. In 2022, Koroku Takano and TOmoe adapted the light novel into a webtoon. Yen Press published the English version of Demons’ Crest.

Devils’ Crest follows Yuuma Ashihara, a grade school student who was “lucky” enough to beta test Actual Magic, a VRMMO. While Yuuma fawned over the game’s realism, his amazement turned to horror when he tried to log out. The game somehow bled into the real world and changed reality to the point where some of his classmates were transformed into monstrous beings ! Now trapped in a life-or-death situation, Yuuma and his classmates must fight to survive.

The anime will premiere on Amazon Prime Video on November 6.
author: Anime Corner

title: Umamusume To Sponsor the 2026 Motul Grand Prix of Japan
content:
Umamusume: Pretty Derby has announced a sponsor partnership with MotoGP™ ahead of the 2026 edition of the Motul Grand Prix of Japan. As part of the sponsorship, a 509′ (155 meters) sign featuring Oguri Cap, Tamamo Cross, Daiwa Scarlet, Jungle Pocket, Agnes Tachyon, Almond Eye, and Lucky Lilac will adorn the race circuit. Umamusume illustrations will be placed by the Motul Grand Prix of Japan’s grandstand entrance. Additionally, Tomoyo Takayanagi ( Oguri Cap ‘s VA), will be the Moto2 and Moto3 flag girl.

This Motul Grand Prix of Japan will be held at the Motegi Circuit in Tochigi Prefecture from October 2 to 4. The Moto2 and Moto3 races are scheduled for Sunday, October 4.

The Moto3 race is an entry-level category designated for lightweight 250cc bikes and younger riders; the Moto2 race features intermediate riders on 765cc motorcycles. The upcoming Japanese race is one of several global Grand Prix races. Tickets for the MotoGP™ Motul Grand Prix of Japan range from a three-day general admission ticket valued at $92.50 (~ ¥14,410) to the three-day Victory Deck Grandstand Seats, which retail for $1666.57 (~ ¥259,707). You can view a short promotional video of the race below.

Umamusume: Pretty Derby ‘s sponsorship of the Motul Grand Prix of Japan marks the second time the franchise has collaborated with a non-horse racing sporting event. Earlier this year, the franchise sponsored the Pacific Racing Team at the Super GT series (car racing). Cygames, Inc. has sponsored and collaborated with various horse racing events, including prestigious races like the Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe , Grand Premio Latinoamericano , and the Breeders’ Cup .

Cygames, Inc. is the parent company of Umamusume: Pretty Derby , a mobile game that features anthropomorphic versions of real-life racehorses. The mobile game has been adapted into several TV anime, OVAs, manga, and a theatrical film.
